name: Central-heating boiler
definition: appliance that heats water for a home's radiators or underfloor circuit; heating-only or combi is a function attribute, fuel a tag, and a combi boiler pack is a unit-of-sale attribute (section 14).
notes: Combi, heat only and system boilers listed; gas and electric

name: Furnace
definition: warm-air heating plant that heats air and sends it through ducts; fuel is a tag (B7-O1).
notes: Gas and oil furnaces listed as a category

name: Panel radiator
definition: flat-panel heat emitter, usually fed by hot water.
notes: Flachheizkoerper and Planheizkoerper listed as radiator product types

name: Column radiator
definition: heat emitter built of upright columns or sections; material and era are attributes.
notes: Column radiators listed, 2 and 3 column

name: Towel radiator
definition: heated rail made to warm and dry towels in a bathroom; hot-water or electric is a power attribute.
notes: Towel radiators in water, electric and dual fuel; Badheizkoerper at Bauhaus

name: Fan heater
definition: room heater that blows air over a heating element; fuel is a tag.
notes: Fan heaters listed with convector, panel, halogen

name: Convector heater
definition: room heater that warms air by natural convection over an element.
notes: Convector heaters listed as a type under Heaters

name: Oil-filled radiator
definition: portable electric heater with sealed oil-filled fins.
notes: Portable and wall-mounted oil-filled radiators listed

name: Radiant heater
definition: heater with an exposed bar, quartz or halogen element and reflector (split from the panel heater by form, provisional).
notes: Halogen and quartz tube heaters sold as a category

name: Infrared panel heater
definition: flat wall- or ceiling-hung panel that heats by infrared radiation; picture-motif prints are variants.
notes: Infrarot-Bildheizkoerper and other infrared panels listed

name: Infrared heat lamp
definition: lamp sold as a heater, not a bulb sold as a part.
notes: Infrared bulb heater fixture sold; bulbs sold separately; Infrared heat lamp bulbs sold as parts for pets and bathroom

name: Flued stove
definition: solid-fuel stove with a firebox vented through a flue (rule T(b), provisional until a fetched source ranks it apart).
notes: Wood and multi-fuel stoves listed

name: Flueless room heater
definition: kerosene or gas room heater with no flue (rule T(b), provisional as above).
notes: Portable flueless gas room heaters listed; Indoor kerosene heaters listed

name: Flued fire
definition: inset or wall-hung fire vented through a flue; fuel is a tag (B7-O1; rule T(b), provisional).
notes: Inset gas fires listed by flue type: brick chimney, pre-cast, pre-fabricated, balanced

name: Underfloor heating kit
definition: electric mat or hydronic pipe kit sold to heat a floor (B7-O1).
notes: Water and electric underfloor heating kits, mats and packs listed

name: Hydronic heat pump
definition: air-to-water heat pump that heats water for radiators or a floor; heat source is an attribute.
notes: Air-source pre-plumbed heat pump kits for heating water

name: Ground-source heat pump
definition: heat pump drawing heat from a ground loop, a kind whatever it delivers (B-24).
notes: Residential geothermal heat pumps, forced air and hydronic

name: Wall-mounted split air conditioner
definition: indoor wall unit linked by refrigerant lines to an outdoor unit; reversible is a tag.
notes: Wall-mounted type listed as the main type

name: Floor-standing air conditioner
definition: split air conditioner whose indoor unit stands on the floor as a cabinet.
notes: Floor-standing type listed

name: Ceiling-cassette air conditioner
definition: split air conditioner whose indoor unit is set into the ceiling.
notes: Ceiling-embedded type listed

name: Window air conditioner
definition: single-box unit fitted in a window or wall opening.
notes: Window type listed

name: Portable air conditioner
definition: movable single-box unit venting through a hose.
notes: Portable cooler type listed

name: Ducted or central system
definition: multi-split or ducted plant cooling several rooms, a ducted heat pump included.
notes: Ducted mini-split and multi-split whole-home systems

name: Desk fan
definition: small fan made to stand on a desk or table.
notes: Desk (takujo) style listed

name: Stationary fan
definition: fan on a stand or pedestal of adjustable height.
notes: Stationary (suekoki) style listed; Pedestal circulators listed

name: Tower fan
definition: tall, narrow fan blowing through a vertical grille.
notes: Tower style listed; Tower fans listed

name: Wall or clip fan
definition: fan made to mount on a wall or clip to an edge (body test against the desk fan provisional, C12(a)).
notes: Wall-mounted and clip styles listed

name: Handheld fan
definition: powered hand-held or neck fan; a manual hand fan is A4 (K-133).
notes: Handheld and neck fans listed

name: Air circulator
definition: fan made to move air round a whole room in a focused stream.
notes: Whole-room air circulators listed

name: Ceiling fan
definition: fan hung from the ceiling, with or without a light.
notes: Ceiling fans with and without lights listed

name: Ventilating fan
definition: fan fitted to draw stale air out of a room.
notes: Bathroom, kitchen and inline extractor fans listed

name: Ventilation unit
definition: ventilation unit for a room or home, with or without heat recovery.
notes: MVHR heat recovery ventilation units listed

name: Air purifier
definition: appliance that filters particles and pollutants from room air; tower or desktop and filter grade are attributes.
notes: Air purifiers listed

name: Humidifier
definition: appliance that adds moisture to room air; mechanism (ultrasonic, evaporative, warm mist) is an attribute (B-25).
notes: Humidifiers listed

name: Portable dehumidifier
definition: movable appliance that draws moisture from room air.
notes: Portable dehumidifiers 20 to 70 pints per day described

name: Whole-house dehumidifier
definition: dehumidifier installed to treat a whole home, usually ducted.
notes: Whole-house ducted dehumidifier sold

name: Mini dehumidifier
definition: small-capacity dehumidifier; Peltier is a technology attribute.
notes: Mini Peltier dehumidifier sold in small dehumidifiers category

name: Deodoriser
definition: appliance made to remove odours from room air.
notes: Air treatment unit sold to sanitise and deodorise rooms

name: Ion generator
definition: appliance that releases ions into room air.
notes: Ion generator (ion hassei ki) listed as an air cleaner type

name: Desiccant moisture absorber
definition: unpowered container of desiccant that absorbs room moisture (K-11).
notes: Disposable, hanging and refillable moisture absorbers sold

name: Thermostat
definition: device that switches heating or cooling to hold a set temperature; smart or plain is a connectivity attribute, and a smart radiator head is filed here.
notes: Smart thermostats and smart radiator thermostats sold
